summary: Tested the ML_ENABLED deployment fix. Preview (ML enabled), live: 21/21 pytest passed (the existing suite plus new flag tests). GET /api/ returns ml_enabled=true and trained=true. /api/meta has ml_enabled and hf_space_url (empty string because HF_SPACE_URL is not set in backend/.env). /api/train/status returns ml_enabled=true with meta. Classify returns a live distilbert result with attention. Production fallback: confirmed `sys.modules['torch']=None; import server` gives ML_ENABLED=False. An in-process simulation (tests/fallback_sim.py, with mocked LLM and an in-memory fake DB, so no real DB writes) confirmed: /api/train returns 503; /api/train/status returns state 'unavailable', the saved train_meta.json, ml_enabled false and trained false; classify returns distilbert=null; eval uses saved predictions with distilbert_source 'saved' and distilbert accuracy 0.75; distilbert_benchmark.json is not overwritten. Frontend: no error overlay or page errors on any of the 6 routes. /training renders the 4 stats (95.0% / 75.0% / 118.3s / 4 ep), the loss chart, the confusion matrix, the domain chart and the PCA chart, and the start button is enabled. /evaluation renders 4 method rows. The fallback UI was checked by mocking API responses with page.route: training-unavailable notice with HF link shows, training-start-btn is disabled, eval-saved-note shows, and the DistilBERT card reads 'runs in preview / HF Space — see Evaluation for saved scores'. No live retraining or full eval was run.

issues: The long 'runs in preview / HF Space…' text squeezes into the card header next to the 'DistilBERT (Keras)' title, which wraps onto two lines. Consider placing the text below the title.

action_items: Optional: set HF_SPACE_URL in the production env so the Training notice links to the Space (the link is hidden while the value is empty)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py catches only ImportError around `import trainer`. If keras/transformers are partly installed on the host and raise a different exception at import time, the backend will crash. Consider `except Exception`.

A live eval (preview) overwrites artifacts/distilbert_benchmark.json. This is intended, but re-running eval after retraining in preview will change the production fallback numbers if they are committed.
requirements.txt does not include torch, keras or transformers (good for production). Preview relies on them being pre-installed.
distilbert_keras.pt (265MB) is gitignored and the JSON artifacts are not, so the fallback data will ship.
seed_data_creation: None. One classify call stored one history entry, as in earlier iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use tests/fallback_sim.py to check the no-torch path without touching the DB. Check the frontend fallback UI by mocking /api/train/status, /api/meta and /api/eval/latest with page.route. Python urllib calls to the public URL return 403, so use page.request instead. Do not retrain or run a full eval.
